thought.text: No node version file, so I'll install a recent Node (>=24). Let me install system deps (apt) and Go, plus Node/pnpm via mise:

reasoning_content:
No .tool-versions for node, so the node devcontainer feature will install the latest version (>=24 is required by package.json). Let me use mise to install node 24 and pnpm 11, and install go for forego. Actually, mise can install node and pnpm too. Let me install everything via mise + apt.

Let me do this step by step. First install apt packages (curl, gnupg, libimlib2-dev, postgresql-client) and go. Then use mise to install node and pnpm.

action.command: docker exec zammad-devcontainer-devcontainer-1 bash -lc 'export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive; sudo apt-get update -qq 2>&1 | tail -3 && sudo apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends curl gnupg libimlib2-dev postgresql-client libimlib2 libimlib2-dev 2>&1 | tail -8; echo "APT_EXIT=$?"'
